title: APR: the 3 letters that can double your debt

lines.text: Three letters on your credit card can almost double what you owe. A, P, R.
lines.say: Three letters on your credit card can almost double what you owe. A. P. R.

scene.headline: The 3 letters that can [double] your debt

lines.text: APR is the yearly price of borrowing money.
lines.say: A P R is the yearly price of borrowing money.

lines.text: A 24% APR works out to about 2% every month.
lines.say: A twenty-four percent A P R works out to about two percent every month.

lines.text: On a $1,000 balance, that's about $20 of interest in a single month.
lines.say: On a one thousand dollar balance, that's about twenty dollars of interest, in a single month.

lines.text: Pay only $25 a month, and it takes 82 months to clear.
lines.say: Pay only twenty-five dollars a month, and it takes eighty-two months to clear.

lines.text: You'd pay about $2,032 in total. Over $1,000 of that is interest.
lines.say: You'd pay about two thousand and thirty-two dollars in total. Over a thousand of that is interest.

lines.text: The good news: on most cards, paying your full statement balance on time means no interest on purchases.

scene.headline: Pay in full, on time: [no interest]

lines.text: That's the money. See you at the next bell.
